remarks: Welcome to 573 Nod Hill Road-a rare blend of historic charm, thoughtful renovations, and an unmatched setting on one of New England's most picturesque and sought-after streets. Recognized in regional publications as one of the most desirable roads to live on, Nod Hill Road is more than a location-it's a community. Set on 2.06 professionally landscaped acres and backing up to the Weir Farm National Historical Park, this 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath home offers peace, privacy, and timeless style just minutes from Wilton's vibrant town center.  Property Highlights: * Originally built in 1800, fully renovated and expanded to offer 3,341 sq ft of stylish, functional living space * Two fireplaces add warmth and ambiance to formal and informal living areas * Gourmet kitchen with granite counters, center island, overlooking stone patios and perennial gardens * Heated saltwater pool and spa, outdoor shower, fire pit, and gazebo-perfect for entertaining or relaxing * Recent upgrades include new roofing (2022), resurfaced driveway, restored stonework, and updated irrigation  Additional Buildings: * The Barn: A finished, heated/cooled two-story barn includes a lounge/game room, full bath, bar, guest suite, office space, and ample storage * The Chapel: A charming, flexible-use outbuilding with heating and air conditioning-perfect as a studio, gym, home office, or guest retreat
